simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֵמוּן (H529) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 5 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֵמוּן (ʼêmûwn) means established , i.e. (figuratively) trusty ; also (abstractly) trustworthiness First listed occurrence: Deut 32 20.

definitions.full: H529. emun אֵמֻן noun [masculine] trusting, faithfulness (on formation compare Ges § 84a R. 12). 1. 1 בָּם אֵמֻן לֹא בָּנִים children in whom there is no trusting Deut 32:20 (poetry) 2. אֱמוּנִים plural abstract faithfulness ; א ׳צִיר messenger of faithfulness , trusty messenger Prov 13:17 ; א ׳עֵד faithful witness 14:5 ; compare א ׳אִישׁ 20:6 ; א ׳שֹׁמֵר keeping faithfulness Isa 26:2 , perhaps also Psa 31:24 א ׳נצד see I. [ אָמַן ].
